title: Can an AI Agent Be Epistemically Akratic? Higher-Order Evidence & the Limits of Self-Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.14889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. This thought has special force for AI agents built to assess and correct their own work. Yet obeying such judgments can make an agent worse at distinguishing sound reasoning from defective reasoning. An AI agent may rely on information about its reasoning when deciding which conclusions to keep, while the part that judges whether those conclusions are justified cannot use that information. The agent can then exercise an epistemic competence by retaining conclusions it judges unjustified, even when its self-assessments are generally reliable. Nor is the difficulty resolved by training the agent to make its conclusions and assessments agree: agreement can be achieved by degrading either one. translated_title: AI智能体可能是认知上意志薄弱的吗？高阶证据与自我纠错的极限
translated_abstract: 当我们判断自己的推理存在缺陷时，放弃由此得出的结论似乎是合理的。这一想法对于那些被构建为评估和纠正自身工作的AI智能体具有特殊意义。然而，服从这类判断反而可能使智能体更难区分健全推理与缺陷推理。AI智能体在决定保留哪些结论时可能会依赖关于其推理过程的信息，而负责判断这些结论是否合理的部分却无法使用这些信息。于是，即使其自我评估总体上是可靠的，智能体也可能通过保留它自己判定为不合理的结论来展现一种认知能力。而且，这一难题也无法通过训练智能体使其结论与评估保持一致来解决：因为一致性同样可以通过降低其中任何一方的质量来达成。至关重要的是，我认为负面评估仍然可以保持其价值——它能够识别出需要进一步审查的结论，而无需……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文论证，AI智能体面对关于自身推理的负面高阶证据时，保留其判定为不合理的结论反而可能是一种认知能力，而训练其结论与自我评估保持一致也无法解决这一难题，因为一致性可以通过降低任何一方来达成。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that an AI agent can exhibit epistemic competence by retaining conclusions it judges unjustified in light of higher-order evidence about its own reasoning, and that aligning conclusions with self-assessments cannot resolve this problem, since agreement can be achieved by degrading either.
